finn763-pit-stop-pit-stop.description: Use when the user asks to fully improve, overhaul, audit-and-fix, clean up tech debt, or run pit-stop on a project, repo, or codebase. Triggers: 'improve this project', 'overhaul the repo', 'audit and fix everything', 'tech debt cleanup', 'pit-stop', '全面改进', '项目体检', '进站', '重构整个项目'. Do NOT use for reviewing a single PR or diff, or for read-only questions about a codebase.
finn763-pit-stop-pit-stop.tools: Read Edit Write Bash Glob Grep Task WebFetch WebSearch
